scripts.build: pnpm --filter @viate-bot/protocol build && pnpm --filter @viate-bot/egress-client build && node scripts/build.mjs release
scripts.build:test: pnpm --filter @viate-bot/protocol build && pnpm --filter @viate-bot/egress-client build && node scripts/build.mjs test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @viate-bot/protocol build && pnpm --filter @viate-bot/egress-client build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --arm64 -c.directories.output=release && node scripts/check-release.mjs release/mac-arm64
scripts.dist:win: pnpm build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --x64 -c.directories.output=release && node scripts/check-release.mjs release/win-unpacked
